beats.label: S1 · The world ended while they were gone
beats.text: Aboard the USS Nathan James in the Arctic, virologists Rachel Scott and Quincy Tophet reveal a virus has killed 80% of humanity while the crew was radio-dark.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the premise every subsequent season inherits: a lone destroyer, a real pandemic, and civilians onboard whose work matters more than the mission they signed up for.

beats.label: S1 · A ship becomes a lab
beats.text: With government contact lost and a nuclear strike in France killing refuel plans, Captain Tom Chandler takes the ship into open sea as Scott's floating laboratory.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This decision defines Chandler's stance for the whole series — the Nathan James answers to the mission, not to whatever authority is claiming to be in charge.

beats.label: S1 · Gitmo and a Russian shadow
beats.text: Refueling at Guantanamo, they recruit private contractor Tex Nolan; Tophet's sabotage delays them just long enough for Admiral Ruskov's Russian cruiser to arrive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Tex, who becomes a permanent fixture on the crew, and pivots the show's antagonist from an invisible virus to a named adversary chasing them.

beats.label: S1 · Why Tophet lied, and what Ruskov wants
beats.text: The ship escapes, learning Tophet was coerced because Russia holds his family hostage, and that Ruskov holds a Norwegian scientist, Niels Sorenson, claimed vital to any cure.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up two threads: an insider aboard whose loyalty is compromised, and the existence of Niels — whose identity as Patient Zero will define the back half of the season.

beats.label: S1 · Chasing the immune, losing the captain
beats.text: Hunting monkeys in Central America and then an immune Jamaican survivor at sea, Chandler and Tex are ambushed during the pickup and taken by the Russians.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The immune-carrier hunt is the concrete step that gets Chandler onto Ruskov's ship, which is where Scott finally meets Patient Zero.

beats.label: S1 · Meeting Patient Zero, sinking Ruskov
beats.text: Traded to the Russians, Scott meets Niels — whose self-experiment made him an asymptomatic carrier — before the crew rescues her and sinks Ruskov's ship. Niels slips away disguised.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Ruskov arc but leaves Niels alive and unaccounted-for, planting the season's real loose thread going forward.

beats.label: S1 · Home is the trap
beats.text: Human trials prove both a vaccine and a cure, but the crew's return to Baltimore is a trap: Amy Granderson's state troopers storm the ship, killing sailors and seizing everything.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season not with the mission accomplished but with the mission stolen — the cure exists and the wrong people now hold it.

cliffhanger.text: Baltimore is a trap: Amy Granderson's troopers hold the Nathan James, its crew, and the world's only vaccine, while Patient Zero Niels Sorenson is loose ashore somewhere in disguise.
questions: Can Chandler retake his ship and the vaccine from Granderson's forces?
What terrible secret is Baltimore's new order hiding behind its facade?
Where has Niels Sorenson gone now that he has escaped alive?

characters.name: Tom Chandler
characters.line: Captain of the USS Nathan James; refused orders home to protect the cure and is now watching armed troopers overrun his ship in Baltimore.

characters.name: Rachel Scott
characters.line: Civilian virologist who developed both a working vaccine and a cure aboard the ship; her research and samples have just been seized by Granderson.

characters.name: Tex Nolan
characters.line: Grizzled private contractor picked up at Guantanamo; unofficially attached to the crew and one of Chandler's most trusted operators.

characters.name: Amy Granderson
characters.line: Surviving Defense Policy board member running the Baltimore facility, and Alisha's mother; has just betrayed the crew to take control of the vaccine.

characters.name: Niels Sorenson
characters.line: Norwegian scientist and Patient Zero of the Red Flu, an asymptomatic carrier whose failed self-experiment spread the current strain; escaped the sinking Russian ship in disguise.

characters.name: Quincy Tophet
characters.line: Virologist who was coerced into sabotaging the ship because Russia held his family hostage; the family has since been rescued.

characters.name: Danny Green
characters.line: Navy operator aboard the Nathan James; the dengue scare that briefly looked like the Red Flu was used to rally the crew behind Scott's work.

characters.name: Kara Foster
characters.line: Ship's officer paired with Danny on the mission to disable Ruskov's cruiser; still aboard the Nathan James.
